allowance(address,address,uint256).details: Returns the amount of tokens of type `id` that `spender` is allowed to spend on behalf of `owner`. NOTE: Does not include operator allowances.

approve(address,uint256,uint256).details: Sets an approval to `spender` for `amount` of tokens of type `id` from the caller's tokens. An `amount` of `type(uint256).max` signifies an unlimited approval. Must return true. WARNING: This function is subject to the same race condition risks as {IERC20-approve}. Changing an allowance with this method brings the risk that `spender` may use both the old and the new allowance by spending the previous allowance while the new one is in-flight. One possible solution to mitigate this race condition is to first reduce `spender`'s allowance to 0 and then set the desired value afterwards.

balanceOf(address,uint256).details: Returns the amount of tokens of type `id` owned by `owner`.

flashLoan(address,address,uint256,bytes).details: Lends any balance the contract holds; the loan is atomic so escrows and pools are never at risk. The post-callback balance check is the point of ERC-3156; every state-changing entry is nonReentrant.

graduate(address,address,uint8,uint64).details: Permissionless. A market graduates after GRADUATION_CYCLES consecutive past expiries that each reached the per-quote volume baseline with no pause and no circuit breaker. Graduation is permanent.

isOperator(address,address).details: Returns true if `spender` is set as an operator for `owner`.

maxFlashLoan(address).details: The amount of currency available to be lent.

returns._0: The amount of `token` that can be borrowed.

pause(bytes32,uint64).details: Only for pools of markets that have not graduated. Blocks new orders and clearing, never cancel, repay, bids or claims. Marks the expiry as bad for graduation.

placeLockedOrder(bytes32,(uint8,uint96,u.details: A commitment order: the owner cannot cancel it while it can still trade. Used for seat obligations.

setOperator(address,bool).details: Grants or revokes unlimited transfer permission of any token id to `spender` for the caller's tokens. Must return true.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

totalSupply(uint256).details: Returns the total supply of the token of type `id`.

transfer(address,uint256,uint256).details: Transfers `amount` of token type `id` from the caller's account to `receiver`. Must return true.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256,uin.details: Transfers `amount` of token type `id` from `sender` to `receiver`. Must return true.

expiryWindowEnd(uint64).notice: Block at which the shared repayment window of `expiry` ends; 0 until the first pool of it matures.

flashFees(address).notice: Cumulative flash-loan fees per token. With marketFees, every amount credited to the treasury is attributable to its source.

marketFees(bytes32).notice: Cumulative spread share collected in a market (in its quote token). Lets the treasury split fees per market, e.g. with the market's seat holder (blueprint §9).
